subject: Request: Penetration test artifacts + remediation timeline for SOC2 audit
messages:
From: Samantha Bryant <samantha.bryant@acme.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: security@acme.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: pen test artifacts and remediation status for upcoming SOC2

Hi Naomi,

We’re finalizing the evidence package for our SOC2 auditor next week and need Redwood’s penetration test deliverables that map to the Control Objective CC6.2 (vulnerability remediation). Specifically:

- The full penetration test executive summary (sanitized if necessary)
- The findings list with severity and remediation owners
- Evidence that mitigations were applied (logs, Jira tickets, patch records) for high and critical items
- A short statement of scope (what was in/out) and test dates

Can you confirm what you can provide by Friday 12/3 and whether any redaction/NDAs are needed?

Thanks,
Samantha
Samantha Bryant
Director, Security Assurance — Acme Financial
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: pen test artifacts and remediation status for upcoming SOC2

Forwarding Acme’s request — they need the 2026-10 penetration test outputs and evidence for the SOC2 package. Ask from Acme:

- Exec summary (sanitized ok)
- Findings with severity + remediation owner + status
- Evidence of remediation for high/critical
- Scope statement and test dates

Monica / Karthik: can you confirm what we can provide without legal redaction? If redaction is required, what is the ETA?
Neha: please surface where the evidence lives (S3 buckets, Jira, patch records) and who can pull artifacts.
Sergio: I may need a short customer-facing note about timing — FYI.

Thanks all — customer asked for confirmation by Friday 12/3.
— Naomi
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 14:42:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: pen test artifacts and remediation status for upcoming SOC2

Naomi — thanks for the ping. Quick summary from Security: we have the full 2026-10 penetration test report (vendor-signed) and an internal findings export. Before we share externally we need to:

- Sanitize PII and internal hostnames (I can produce a sanitized executive summary PDF)
- Remove vendor tool traces per contract (small redactions)
- Produce a remediation matrix that maps each finding to an owner, status and Jira ticket — I’ll attach a CSV export.

Current status / ETA:
- Sanitized exec summary: 12/1 EOD
- Remediation matrix draft (internal): 12/1 afternoon
- Evidence bundle (logs, Jira links, patch artifacts): inventory by 12/2, bundle by 12/3

Blocking items: legal review for any contractual redaction and confirmation if Acme needs raw screenshots/stack traces (we usually redact). Karthik, can you confirm if we should include raw attachments for auditors under the current customer NDA?

I’ll attach drafts once ready.
— Monica
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: pen test artifacts and remediation status for upcoming SOC2

Monica / team — thanks. A few clarifications and commitments from Security leadership:

- Under the standard customer NDA we can provide a sanitized executive summary and the remediation matrix. Raw exploit artifacts (screenshots, pcap, raw tool output) are considered sensitive; we will only provide them to the auditor under an executed mutual NDA addendum or via an on-site review.
- For each HIGH/CRITICAL item we will provide: the remediation ticket link (Jira), a short remediation note, and a verification artifact (deployment timestamp / patch manifest / scan result).

I’ve started a short remediation status list (quick view) below — this will be expanded into the CSV:
- HIGH: Auth bypass in auth-service — owner: neha_kapoor — status: fixed 2026-11-15 — evidence: Jira RED-1345, deployment tag v1.7.3
- CRITICAL: Unauthenticated S3 write allowed on staging S3 bucket — owner: monica_patel (tasked Eng) — status: mitigated 2026-11-20 — evidence: IAM policy change log, cloudtrail export
- HIGH: Outdated third-party crypto lib on worker nodes — owner: devops_team (cc: neha_kapoor) — status: scheduled 2026-12-04 patch window

I will review the CSV for accuracy and add remediation verification summaries by 12/2 EOD. Legal: if Acme’s auditor requires raw evidence, we’ll need a short mutual access agreement; Naomi / Sergio, happy to coordinate.

— Karthik
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 13:07:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: pen test artifacts and remediation status for upcoming SOC2

Quick evidence notes — where artifacts live and contact for pull:

- Jira tickets: RED-1345, RED-1402, RED-1420 — accessible to our customer-audit group (redwood-security-audit)
- S3 evidence: s3://redwood-prod-evidence/pentest/2026-10/ (manifest attached: s3_evidence_manifest.txt) — read-only links can be generated for auditors; I’ll create pre-signed URLs if legal okays it.
- Deployment manifests: builds tagged in GitHub: release/v1.7.3 and release/v1.7.4 — I can pull the Docker image digests and sha256 for verification

Note on the crypto lib HIGH item: we have a scheduled patch job for 12/04; we can provide the patch PR and the pipeline run logs as verification once completed.

I’ll upload the sanitized exec summary and remediation_matrix_2026-10.csv to the Security SharePoint and attach them here when done.
— Neha
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Bryant <samantha.bryant@acme.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Dec 2026 17:28:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Request: pen test artifacts and remediation status for upcoming SOC2

Hi Samantha — thanks for the ask and apologies for the back-and-forth. Summary and plan:

What we will provide by 12/03 EOD:
- Sanitized executive summary (attached: redwood_pen_test_2026-10-exec-summary-sanitized.pdf)
- Remediation matrix CSV mapping each finding to owner, status and Jira link (attached: remediation_matrix_2026-10.csv)
- Inventory of evidence with pre-signed links available upon NDA confirmation (s3_evidence_manifest.txt attached)

What we need from Acme to share raw artifacts:
- Confirmation whether the auditor will accept sanitized artifacts or needs unredacted evidence. If unredacted is required, please have your legal team send the mutual access form or confirm an auditor-only access agreement.

Next steps:
- Monica / Karthik will finalize the remediation verification rows by 12/02 EOD
- Neha will provision pre-signed S3 links and share them once Legal confirms access terms
- I’ll send a short customer-facing note with the timeline and attach the sanitized docs now.

If you’d like a 15-minute sync to walk through the artifacts, I’m available tomorrow 10–11am PT.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com | (415) 555-0199
Attachments: redwood_pen_test_2026-10-exec-summary-sanitized.pdf (pdf), remediation_matrix_2026-10.csv (csv), s3_evidence_manifest.txt (text)
